# Design fixes for Logan

Prose errors builders found in `docs/design` while building. Code PRs do not edit design prose (CLAUDE.md); Logan fixes these in the design and syncs them in. Strike a row through once it lands.

| # | Where | Problem | Suggested fix |
|---|---|---|---|

| 2 | data/README.md, batch 155 paragraph | Borrowing at base + zone spread + rating is stale; spec 5.12 uses the home spread (half zone, half sovereign) | Point to spec 5.12 |

| 6 | 12-tech-and-roadmap 12.6 | Table widget in M9; build-plan moved it to M7.7 | Say M7.7 |

| 10 | mvp-spec 9.3 | No notice says why the game paused (a SkipTo finishing, an alert, a load), and `alert(kind, payload)` has no level, so the UI cannot tell Notify from Log | Give `paused(reason)` named reasons and `alert` its level, as the build does (D6, D10) |

Demand never matches validate.py's year-end figures | State that the job closes the month just ended with that month's quarter's growth (build decision D100) |

| 208 | tools/mvp-data/validate.py `steady_held`, `normal_company` vs mvp-spec 5.9, 7.1 | Two divergences from the engine at the smallest companies. (a) `steady_held` bisects from a 1 TB floor, so for any conversion C below the decay base (0.02 TB a month) it returns 1 TB and 1% free R&D; spec 5.9 gives C ÷ base, under 1 TB and 0%. That hits 11 companies with $0.1M to $0.4M of revenue (14 counting the three barebones companies validate.py models at $0.1M), so their free R&D is 1% in validate.py and 0% in the engine. (b) `normal_company` counts `ceil(0.5 × R ÷ 10.95)` enterprise stations uncapped, but CO-0025, CO-0046, CO-0094 and CO-0096 have one labor unit, so the engine caps them at 0 (D208): no licence and no conversion | Fix validate.py: start the bisection at 0 (or return C ÷ base below base) and cap enterprise stations at the labor left after productivity, so the 619-of-651 profit check models what the engine loads |
